name: Strata
author: Reflectionist
description: A 2D workspace grid for Hyprland: workspaces stack as named strata on one shared horizontal axis, with free placement of columns (blank space between windows), per-stratum app routing, themes and wallpapers, a zoomable overview with drag-and-drop, and a navigation preview. Includes a native Hyprland layout plugin, built locally by its setup.

barWidget.description: The current stratum's glyph. Left click: settings. Right click: overview. Scroll: previous / next stratum.
